OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER
FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091 (4 Sep 45) MG
(SCAPIN - 6)
APO 500
4 September 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office Number 1
SUBJECT : Military Factory Employees
1. In reply to the request from the Imperial General Headquarters in Tokyo regarding the number, if any, of workers who are to remain at their posts in the military factories of the Harmachida and Tachikawa areas, the Supreme Commander directs that each military factory will maintain a minimum administrative staff for the proper keeping of books, records and other managerial details, and also its normal guard for policing the factories and premises.
2. The number of workers to remain in each factory for both purposes will approximate not more than two or three per cent of the total employed.
3. Some means at your discretion, will be devised to maintain effective control over skilled and technically trained labor.
4. These instructions will be acknowledged together with a report of what has been accomplished.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair
/t/ HAROLD FAIR,
Lt. Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
